title: Original Anvil Recipe
description: Maybe you have too much iron? The original anvil recipe will help with that issue.
body:
# Original Anvil Recipe

This is just a simple recipe data pack, nothing special.

12w41a; Anvils currently require one iron ingot and six blocks of iron. 12w42a; Anvils now have an easier crafting recipe.

The original recipes requires 6 blocks of iron and 1 iron ingot. 3 blocks on top, 1 ingot in the middle, and 3 blocks on the bottom.

**Side Note**: The game will most likely tell you that the data pack is out of data depending on the version you are choosing to play but it works just fine 1.13-1.20
